production.note: US model years. The 2008 press kit (infiniti-us-2008-g37-coupe-press-kit): the car was 'set to arrive at INFINITI retailers nationwide in August 2007' as the 2008 model; the 2013 G Coupe press kit calls 2013 'the sixth year of its current generation design'. The G37 Convertible (2009 on), the AWD G37x Coupe and the IPL G Coupe are not covered by this record.

aspiration.note: '3.7-liter VVEL 24-valve DOHC V6'; no forced induction.

drivetrain.note: Rear-wheel drive at launch; the AWD G37x Coupe (2009 on) is sold as its own model and not covered here.

transmission.note: 2008: 'electronically controlled 5-speed automatic transmission' or 'close-ratio lightweight 6-speed manual transmission' (manual on the G37 Coupe Sport 6MT). The 2013 G Coupe press kit (infiniti-us-2013-g-coupe-press-kit) lists a '7-speed automatic transmission with manual mode' and the Sport 6MT's '6-speed manual transmission'.

powerHp.note: Quote (Infiniti USA 2008 G37 Coupe specification): "Horsepower 330 hp @ 7,000 rpm". Press kit: '330 horsepower and 270 lb-ft of torque'. The 2013 G Coupe press kit gives the same '330 horsepower and 270 lb-ft of torque' (the IPL G Coupe's 348 hp is a separate model).

weightLb.note: G37 Coupe Sport 6MT (the manual car), 2008. Quote (Infiniti USA specification, columns 'G37 Coupe G37 Coupe Journey G37 Coupe Sport 6MT'): "Curb weight 3,616 lb 3,624 lb 3,668 lb" (repeated on a second request). The base automatic coupe is 3,616 lb; the Sport 6MT also carries sport equipment. 2013 G Coupe press kit: Journey 3,633 lb, Sport 6MT 3,708 lb.
